Package dev.turboism.sdk.ui.context

Record Class ContextMenuSelection

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.turboism.sdk.ui.context.ContextMenuSelection
Record Components:
hostGeneration - host/session generation that produced the selection
documentId - non-blank SDK document identity
location - non-null semantic menu location
items - immutable selected items, which may be empty when the host supplies no selection

Throws: NullPointerException if documentId, location, or items is null

Throws: IllegalArgumentException if documentId is blank

public record ContextMenuSelection(long hostGeneration, String documentId, ContextMenuRegistry.Location location, List<ContextMenuSelection.Item> items) extends Record
Immutable selection supplied to an object-context-menu action.

The values are bound to hostGeneration and documentId; they are semantic identifiers, not live host objects. Do not reuse them to infer a replacement object after a document change, reload, or host replacement. The runtime supplies this selection only for an admitted context-menu invocation.
